summary: Woman in her 80s was attacked ~4:30 a.m. inside her Estes Park home (Windcliff neighborhood) by an adult bear that entered through a closed-but-unlocked first-floor window; the bear charged her in the second-floor kitchen, scratched her across the stomach and knocked her down; she sought medical treatment; Larimer County Sheriff's deputies responded; bear not located.
responding_agency: Colorado Parks and Wildlife, Larimer County Sheriff's Office
notes: Fort Collins Coloradoan 8/28/2026 (corroborates CPW release); USDA APHIS assisting CPW in locating the bear; 'extraordinary bear year'.
